title: Supported coefficient tensor comparison under second-variable open restriction
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, f:X→S and g:Y→S scheme morphisms, b:B→X and d:D→Y closed immersions, and V an open of Y. For arbitrary unbounded derived A-module complexes M,N, let h:X×_S V→X×_S Y be the canonical open map and τ the normalized supported coefficient derived tensor comparison [def-pur-supported-exterior-product]. The product support coefficient mate [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-derived-open-mate], followed by h*(τ) and the exact pullback tensor isomorphism [def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons], equals τ on X×_S V followed by the tensor of the uncut first projection coefficient comparison and the cut second-coefficient mate. All projection and pullback-composition factors are the canonical ones displayed in the attached Lean statement. This is a coefficient identity, with no supported section inputs or evaluation maps.

source.place: Tags 09XP and 0F1E; coefficient normalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization, with exact derived mate calculation.

proof.text: The ordinary coefficient tensor square is proved in [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-ordinary-second-open-tensor]. It normalizes the three coefficient maps by their constant quotients and uses compatibility of the canonical projection comparisons.

By [lem-pur-supported-tensor-complex-square] the ordinary equality passes to signed total complexes. Check the signed total comparison on each tensor bidegree and descend along K-flat models using the defining normalization of the supported derived comparison. Naturality and existence of K-flat resolutions give the equality on arbitrary coefficient complexes. Apply [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-derived-open-mate] to identify the localized ordinary mate with the specified derived open support mate; the canonical projection comparison isomorphisms give exactly the displayed uncut first and cut second maps. No interchange of the tensor variables is performed.

theorem supportedCoefficientTensor_openSecond (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {S X Y B D : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (b : B ⟶ X) (d : D ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion b] [IsClosedImmersion d] (V : Y.Opens)
    (M N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) :
    (supportCoefficientOpenMate A (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V)
      (supportedProductImmersion f g b d)
      (supportedProductImmersion f (V.ι ≫ g) b (supportOnOpen d V))
      (supportedSecondOpenSupport_complement f g b d V)).app (M ⊗ N) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (supportedCoefficientTensorDerived A f g b d M N) ≫
      (supportExactPullbackTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V)
        ((supportedFirstCoefficients A f g b).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
        ((supportedSecondCoefficients A f g d).mapDerivedCategory.obj N)).hom =
    supportedCoefficientTensorDerived A f (V.ι ≫ g) b (supportOnOpen d V) M N ≫
      supportedDerivedTensorMap A (pullback f (V.ι ≫ g))
        (supportSecondOpenFirstCoefficientMap A f g b V M)
        (supportSecondOpenCoefficientMap A f g d V N)
